reply.text: {"say":"Here is your garage push day: heavy flat bench first, then incline dumbbells and overhead pressing, finishing with lateral raises and two triceps movements.","title":"Push Day","days":[{"name":"Push","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the chest, drive through your feet.\u0000"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline, control the lowering."},{"key":"barbell-overhead-press","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze glutes, press straight up past your face."},{"key":"dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with elbows, no swinging."},{"key":"dumbbell-skull-crusher","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep elbows pointed at the ceiling."},{"key":"diamond-push-up","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows tight to your sides."}]}],"unmet":[]}
